name: AppConfig
description: Singleton-per-schema configuration row describing the running app to itself. Created/overwritten by the deploy flow (Trillo AI is the source of truth — every redeploy overwrites). Drives CORS gating (frontendUrl + allowedCorsOrigins), per-app branding (logos, favicon, auth cover), chat/auth/legal UI settings, and tenancy mode. One row per app schema; id is always 1. dataApi: open with read-only ACL — admin and user can read via generic CRUD for branding + flags at app load; writes go through AppConfigController (which runs the emailLinkBackUrl validator + other side effects that direct PATCH would bypass). Plan-54: TrilloMD-side editor is the canonical edit surface and ships values via redeploy; AOS-side composer at GET /api/v2.0/md/app-config aggregates this row with computed identity (tenantId, appId) and deploy state for the UI.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Singleton id — always 1. Not autoSequence; deploy explicitly sets id=1 on create.

attributes.name: appId
attributes.description: The app this config represents. Matches Tenant.id in MA-ST/SA-ST; for SA-MT this is the deployment's single app id. Used as a verification field — deploy sets it from the deploy context.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Internal kebab name (e.g., 'trillo-ai'). Stable across deploys; used as the app identifier in URLs, logs, metrics. Projected as 'appName' in the /md/app-config composer response.

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: Human-readable label rendered in UI headers and metadata (e.g., 'Trillo AI Studio'). Projected as 'appDisplayName' in the /md/app-config composer response.

attributes.name: tagline
attributes.description: Plan-56 — welcome-screen subtitle shown beneath appDisplayName.

attributes.name: companyName
attributes.description: Plan-56 — company name used in UI footer and HTML meta tags.

attributes.name: logoUrl
attributes.description: DEPRECATED — kept as a transitional alias for logoIconUrl. UI should switch to logoIconUrl; this field will be removed in a follow-up plan. Composer mirrors logoIconUrl into this key for one minor version.

attributes.name: logoIconUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — square icon (PNG/SVG, ≥64×64) shown in the sidebar logo slot and on the welcome screen. Nullable — UI falls back to a default mark.

attributes.name: logoTextUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — optional wordmark image. When present, replaces the textual appDisplayName next to the logo icon.

attributes.name: faviconUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — browser tab icon. Nullable — UI falls back to logoIconUrl.

attributes.name: authCoverUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — background image used on auth pages (login, register, forgot-password).

attributes.name: darkLogoIconUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — optional alternate logo icon for dark mode. UI uses logoIconUrl if absent.

attributes.name: darkLogoTextUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — optional alternate logo wordmark for dark mode. UI uses logoTextUrl if absent.

attributes.name: frontendUrl
attributes.description: Primary UI origin (e.g., 'https://app.example.com'). Auto-included in the CORS allow-list at boot. Required for any non-localhost UI to reach AOS APIs. Plan-56: also the strict-same-origin reference for emailLinkBackUrl validation on auth flows.

attributes.name: allowedCorsOrigins
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional origins to allow for CORS (e.g., 'https://staging.example.com,https://preview-*.example.com'). frontendUrl is auto-included — listed separately for clarity. Optional.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: Default IANA timezone for UI date rendering (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'). Optional — UI may override per-user via UserPreference.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Default BCP-47 locale for UI string formatting (e.g., 'en-US'). Optional — UI may override per-user.

attributes.name: multiTenant
attributes.description: Plan-55 — per-app tenancy mode. false (default) = MA-ST behavior (bootstrap admin owns tenant 0; no user-created tenants). true = MA-MT behavior (registration creates a new Tenant per user; many tenants per app schema). Immutable after first user registration — flipping it post-hoc rearranges data semantics and requires the Trillo-AI-side 'clone app' flow. Embedded in the issued JWT at login so authenticated handlers read it from RequestContext without a per-request DB hit; unauthenticated login/register endpoints do one lookup on this column before issuing the JWT or branching the register flow. Projected as 'tenancy' string in the /md/app-config composer response.

attributes.name: chatMaxFileUploadMb
attributes.description: Plan-56 — maximum file upload size (in megabytes) accepted by the chat surface. Projected under chat.maxFileUploadMb in the composer response.

attributes.name: chatEnableConversationPinning
attributes.description: Plan-56 — toggle for the chat conversation-pinning UX. Projected under chat.enableConversationPinning.

attributes.name: chatEnableConversationRename
attributes.description: Plan-56 — toggle for the chat conversation-rename UX. Projected under chat.enableConversationRename.

attributes.name: chatEnableConversationDelete
attributes.description: Plan-56 — toggle for the chat conversation-delete UX. Projected under chat.enableConversationDelete.

attributes.name: chatEmptyStateText
attributes.description: Plan-56 — overrides the default empty-state copy on the chat surface. Null = UI uses its built-in copy. Projected under chat.emptyStateText.

attributes.name: authPasswordMinLength
attributes.description: Plan-56 — minimum password length enforced by the registration / change-password flow. Projected under auth.passwordPolicy.minLength.

attributes.name: authPasswordRequireNumber
attributes.description: Plan-56 — require at least one digit in the password. Projected under auth.passwordPolicy.requireNumber.

attributes.name: authPasswordRequireSymbol
attributes.description: Plan-56 — require at least one symbol in the password. Projected under auth.passwordPolicy.requireSymbol.

attributes.name: authPasswordRequireUppercase
attributes.description: Plan-56 — require at least one uppercase letter in the password. Projected under auth.passwordPolicy.requireUppercase.

attributes.name: authForgotPasswordRedirectUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — where the UI sends the user after a successful password reset. Must satisfy strict same-origin with frontendUrl when non-null; the composer / validator enforces this on PUT. Projected under auth.forgotPasswordRedirectUrl.

attributes.name: authSessionTimeoutMinutes
attributes.description: Plan-56 — refresh-token lifetime hint for the auth store (minutes). Default 1440 = 24 hours. Projected under auth.sessionTimeoutMinutes.

attributes.name: legalPrivacyUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — link to the tenant's privacy policy, rendered in the UI footer. Projected under legal.privacyUrl.

attributes.name: legalTermsUrl
attributes.description: Plan-56 — link to the tenant's terms of service, rendered in the UI footer. Projected under legal.termsUrl.

attributes.name: smsEnabled
attributes.description: Plan-62.A — whether SMS sending is enabled for this app. Declarative marker for the admin UI; effective sending also requires Twilio credentials (per-app AppSecret twilioAccountSid/twilioAuthToken/twilioFromNumber, or platform Env fallback).

attributes.name: smsProvider
attributes.description: Plan-62.A — SMS dispatch provider. Only 'twilio' in V1; the SmsProvider abstraction allows more later. Credentials live in AppSecret, not here.

attributes.name: authMfaEnabled
attributes.description: Plan-62.B — whether MFA is offered for this app (master switch). When true, users may opt in (UserMfaSettings.mfaEnabled).

attributes.name: authGuestEnabled
attributes.description: Whether this app is publicly available (usable without signup). A product/UI flag the frontend reads to offer the app to unauthenticated visitors. It does NOT gate guest function/agent execution — that is gated per-item by the function/agent's role:guest declaration. Default false.

attributes.name: authMfaRequired
attributes.description: Plan-62.B — when true, MFA is enforced for ALL users of the app at login (regardless of per-user opt-in).

attributes.name: authMfaMethods
attributes.description: Plan-62.B — comma-separated OTP delivery methods the app allows: email,sms. V1 has no TOTP.

attributes.name: driveAccess
attributes.description: Plan-62.C — which Google Drive connection(s) the app enables: 'perUser' (each user's own Drive, connected at Google login), 'appLevel' (one admin-connected shared account), or 'both' (UI shows both as separate nodes). Drive ops take a 'scope' (user|app|auto) to pick the connection; auto = the user's if connected, else app-level.
